label: Bybit (Unified)
notes: Bybit's key-info endpoint must show NO Wallet/Transfer permission and a Contract or Spot trade permission.
terms_note: V5 unified REST API; HMAC-SHA256 header signing (X-BAPI-*); failures come back as HTTP 200 with retCode != 0. place_order and cancel_order move real funds.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Bybit API key (system-generated HMAC key) with Read + Trade (Spot/Contract) and NO Wallet/Transfer/Withdraw permission. Testnet keys come from https://testnet.bybit.com and work only against https://api-testnet.bybit.com (set adapter.base_url to it).

fields.name: api_secret
fields.help: The key's secret: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + api_key + recv_window (5000) + query string (GET) or JSON body (POST), sent as X-BAPI-SIGN. Never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: category
config_fields.help: Bybit product category every tool works on: `spot` or `linear` (USDT/USDC perpetuals and futures).

me.note: API key information: readOnly, permissions (check that Wallet/Withdraw is empty), ips, uta, isMaster.

list_markets.note: Instruments of the configured category in one call (spot has no pagination; linear is asked for 1000, the maximum; further cursor pages are not fetched). `query` is not sent.

get_ticker.note: Decimal strings passed through; price24hPcnt is a fraction (-0.0126 = -1.26%).

get_candles.note: Intervals 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,12h,1d,1w,1M. Rows come NEWEST FIRST; `time` is the start time in ms (string) and values are decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

get_balances.note: Unified trading account, non-zero coins only; account totals (totalEquity, totalAvailableBalance) are in each row's context under the raw response.

list_orders.note: Open orders (first 50). For `linear` Bybit needs a symbol or settle coin, so settleCoin=USDT is sent: pass `symbol` for USDC contracts. `status` is not sent.

place_order.note: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the Bybit testnet https://api-testnet.bybit.com first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. On `linear` this opens or adds to a LEVERAGED position. `quantity` is in the base coin (spot market orders are sent with marketUnit=baseCoin; Bybit's own default for spot market buys is quote coin). Limit orders rest GTC (Bybit's default) and need `price`. Creation is asynchronous: status `submitted` means accepted, check list_orders.

cancel_order.note: Bybit requires `symbol` with the order id; cancellation is asynchronous.

auth: Headers X-BAPI-API-KEY, X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP (ms), X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW, X-BAPI-SIGN = lowercase hex HMAC_SHA256 of timestamp + API key + recv_window + queryString (GET) or jsonBodyString (POST).

endpoints.notes: category required; limit 1-1000 (default 500), cursor; spot: no pagination
lastPrice, bid1Price, ask1Price, volume24h, turnover24h, price24hPcnt, highPrice24h, lowPrice24h
interval 1,3,5,15,30,60,120,240,360,720,D,W,M; limit 1-1000 (default 200); rows [start, open, high, low, close, volume, turnover] newest first
accountType=UNIFIED; result.list[0].coin[] {coin, walletBalance, equity, locked, unrealisedPnl, usdValue}
linear: symbol, baseCoin or settleCoin required; limit max 50
category, symbol, side Buy|Sell, orderType Market|Limit, qty (string); price for Limit; timeInForce default GTC; marketUnit for spot market orders

reference.limits: Per-UID endpoint limits (e.g. 10-20 req/s for order endpoints) plus 600 requests per 5 s per IP.

live_check.notes: requires api_key, api_secret, category; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
